title: Why Serious Runway Near-Misses Keep Climbing
hook: Serious runway danger more than doubled in about a decade.
closing: Every runway near-miss is a warning before the collision that cannot be undone.
question: Which airport risk worries you most?

segments.say: Safety officials logged 23 serious runway near-misses last year, more than double the pace from about a decade earlier.
Six in ten of those incidents came from people or vehicles entering a runway by mistake.
Just 8 airports, including Boston and Chicago Midway, hold almost a third of the worst near-misses.
